last.verdict: Record sales came from Alani Nu, but costs keep squeezing margins, the flagship CELSIUS brand is still shrinking, and fourth-quarter growth will slow.

takeaways.label: Margins keep sliding
takeaways.text: Gross margin fell to 46.8% from 51.3% a year ago and 48.1% last quarter. Aluminum and diesel costs rose further, and management expects only high-40s for the full year.

takeaways.label: Alani Nu carries growth
takeaways.text: Alani Nu sales rose 24% to $410M, with a record seasonal flavor. CELSIUS brand sales fell 6% to $357M, and management said it is 'not yet where we want it to be.'

takeaways.label: Growth slows next
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter growth is guided below the first three quarters. About $20-25M of shipments were pulled into Q3, and last year's quarter had a one-time inventory benefit. No numeric targets were given.

takeaways.label: Reorganization and fixes
takeaways.text: Brand-led leadership is now in place, with new presidents for CELSIUS and Rockstar. Management says 2027 'will look very different' for CELSIUS, with new flavors and a second North Carolina production line.

history.verdict: Big revenue and profit miss, with the flagship CELSIUS brand shrinking again.

reasons.label: Flagship brand shrinking
reasons.text: CELSIUS brand sales fell about 12%; management admitted cutting too many products.

reasons.label: Missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $818M trailed the roughly $870M expected; adjusted EPS $0.36 vs $0.42.

reasons.label: Margins stay squeezed
reasons.text: Gross margin was 48.1% vs 51.5% a year ago; aluminum costs and promotions weighed.
